# Panoramica Solutions

> RevOps implementation for early-stage teams. AI-enabled systems built inside your stack, each with a defined scope and a clear price.

Panoramica Solutions is run by Lorenzo Liviero, a RevOps operator. Client names stay private.

## Services

- [Email outreach infrastructure](https://www.panoramica.solutions/email-outreach.html): A model writes each email from what your database knows about the contact, and sends it from domains and accounts you own. Custom scope.
- [Data foundation](https://www.panoramica.solutions/database.html): We define who you sell to, then source, enrich, verify, deduplicate and score the companies and contacts, and load them into your CRM. Custom scope.
- [Goldmine](https://www.panoramica.solutions/goldmine.html): Goldmine cross-references your CRM history, calls, emails and notes on every lead, adds outside research, and delivers a ranked queue every day. £6,000 / £8,500 / £11,000.
- [The Brief](https://www.panoramica.solutions/the-brief.html): A brief lands in Gmail before every external meeting: the facts, a behavioral profile of the person, and advice for the call. £1,000 fixed setup.
- [Revenue Architect](https://www.panoramica.solutions/revenue-architect.html): A guided diagnostic that argues with your first answer, then hands you an action plan. £149 self-serve.
- [Marketing Studio](https://www.panoramica.solutions/the-studio.html): Social images, carousels, PDFs, one-pagers, landing pages and emails, planned as a campaign and held for your approval. £7,500 fixed build.
